newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia tenders $63.4 million in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia tenders $63.4 million in T-bills.

text.p: The central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) on Monday tendered for sale treasury bills valued at 400 million birr ($63.4 million).
The bills were for 28-day, 91-day and 182-day categories and are to be issued on Wednesday March 26, 1997.

The amounts tendered were 200 million birr for 28-day bills maturing on April 23, some 150 million birr for 91-day bills maturing on June 25 and 50 million birr for 182-day bills maturing on September 24. ($ = 6.308 Ethiopian Birr)
